title: Detailed hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Balloon envelope - outer shape -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="28" ry="30" fill="#FF4444"/>
  
  <!-- Vertical stripes -->
  <path d="M50 8 C50 8, 32 15, 28 38 C26 50, 30 62, 36 68 L38 66 C33 60, 30 50, 31 38 C33 20, 47 12, 50 10 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <path d="M50 8 C50 8, 68 15, 72 38 C74 50, 70 62, 64 68 L62 66 C67 60, 70 50, 69 38 C67 20, 53 12, 50 10 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  
  <!-- Center stripe -->
  <path d="M50 8 C47 12, 43 22, 42 38 C41 50, 43 62, 50 68 C57 62, 59 50, 58 38 C57 22, 53 12, 50 8 Z" fill="#44AAFF"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="22" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#FF8888" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon bottom curve highlight -->
  <path d="M30 55 C32 62, 38 66, 50 68 C62 66, 68 62, 70 55" fill="none" stroke="#FF6666" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Ropes -->
  <line x1="36" y1="67" x2="42" y2="78" stroke="#AA6622" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="64" y1="67" x2="58" y2="78" stroke="#AA6622" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Basket -->
  <rect x="40" y="78" width="20" height="12" rx="2" fill="#BB7722"/>
  <rect x="40" y="78" width="20" height="3" rx="1" fill="#DD9944"/>
  
  <!-- Basket weave lines -->
  <line x1="40" y1="83" x2="60" y2="83" stroke="#996611" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="86" x2="60" y2="86" stroke="#996611" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="47" y1="78" x2="47" y2="90" stroke="#996611" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="78" x2="53" y2="90" stroke="#996611" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Burner flame -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="75" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFAA00"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="73" rx="1.5" ry="2.5" fill="#FFDD44"/>
  
  <!-- Burner -->
  <rect x="46" y="70" width="8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#CCCCCC"/>
  <rect x="48" y="68" width="4" height="3" rx="1" fill="#AAAAAA"/>
</svg>
